scenes.title: Sela Thorn at pier four
scenes.summary: The party looks for a boat and meets Sela Thorn, a tide-reader who will row them to the old chapel for two silver, but never at night. She says Saltmere Mine flooded the night the bell first rang forty years ago, and offers to take them tomorrow at first light.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in the Saltmere Mine
scenes.place: Saltmere Mine, up the cliff path from Gullwick
scenes.summary: The party explores the warm, flooded mine entrance and finds wet hymn-book pages floating on the water. One page has "M. Brand" pencilled in the margin, which Teo recognises as his sister Mira's handwriting. Dana and Oren suspect the harbor-master Maren of leading the cult.

scenes.title: Midnight bell at the drowned chapel
scenes.place: Shore below the old chapel ruins, Gullwick bay
scenes.summary: At dusk the party goes to the shore despite Sela's warning. Fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother, and at midnight the bell rings twelve times under the water with a louder hum. Pale congregation-like shapes stand on the chapel floor, then vanish, and the party flees.

scenes.title: Planning the dive at the Tarred Gull
scenes.place: The Tarred Gull, tavern by the docks
scenes.summary: The party plans to row out with Sela at first light and dive to the chapel at low tide. Innkeeper Bram feeds them and says he has known Maren for thirty years and that she lost a brother to the bay. The party takes a long rest and the session ends.
